title: Wear Turbans and Be in Safety
body:
A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem.

SubhaanAllahi ‘l-`Aliyyi 'l-`Azheem.
As-salaamu `alaykum yaa `ibaadAllah. A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem. Allahamdulillahi ‘lladhee ja`alana min ummati ’l-Habeeb, Habeebillah, nooru `Arshillah. That is the biggest honor for us. So
many prophets have passed away, and the honor of their nations is according to their prophets.
We are saying, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem. Tawbah, yaa
Rabbee. Tawbah, yaa Rabbee. Tawbah, astaghfirullah. Allah (swt) granted to His beloved, Sayyidi 'lAwwaleen wa ’l-Akhireen, Nabiyu ’r-Rahmah, Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits.)
We have been granted such an honor when Allah Almighty was revealing about the honor of His most
blessed, most praised, most glorified, most majestic one (s). Then all prophets asked, "O our Lord! Let us be
from his nation, not to be messengers!" And messengerhood is not an ordinary honor; it is an exceptional
honor just granted to 124,000 prophets. All were asking, "O our Lord! Instead of making us prophets, let us
be from his nation!" And Allah Almighty was saying, "No, I have granted to him his nation, the most honored
of all nations, and I am granting you the honor of messengerhood."

The Lord of Heavens only accepted among all prophets Jesus Christ, Sayyidina `Isa (a), to be from his nation.
Therefore, `Isa (a) was raised up and Allah Almighty is protecting him as he was for perhaps 2000 years, and
he is now like he was since the day of his rising to Heavens. Allah Almighty promised him, "I am sending you
as one of My beloved one's nation. They are going back to the ways of jahiliyya, asking to be like in the Days
of Ignorance." And that is real truth that Allah Almighty is saying, because now people from ummat alHabeeb are not appreciating the honor granted to them to be from the nation of the Seal of Prophets (s). "At
that time, I am sending Jesus Christ to come to Mankind for a second time on Earth, to complete his
mission.”
He is coming now, not coming as a prophet, but as a follower of the Seal of Prophets (s). Jesus Christ (a) is
coming on the day appointed by heavenly order and on his head will be the crown of Islam, the turban! First
Arabs are running away from turbans; they hate turbans and those who are putting turbans on their heads.
They never like it, particularly Salaaf us-Saalih people and their foolish followers, Wahabi people! They are
never using the crown of Islam and if they are see someone wearing a turban, they act like they are seeing a
snake! Why? And Rasoolullah (s) said:
••••••• ••••• •••••
al-`amaa’imu tijaanu ’l-`Arab
“Turbans are the crowns of Arabs,” wa nahnu al-`Arab ma’mooroon, (and we are the Arabs, we have been
ordered).
First they are Muslims, then Arabs, and we have been ordered to wear turbans, but they left the crown of
Islam, while we are running to keep it! They are the first to leave it, and hadeeth nabawiyyatu ’sh-shareef
says, al-`amaaimu tijaanu ’l-`Arab. Now if you are speaking about that, so many jaahil, ignorant followers of
Shaytan will say, "It is not a true hadith." Who is writing that hadith, are they bringing it from their homes?
What is that foolishness? And in the Holy Qur'an, Allah `azza wa jall is making it clear that on the Day of
Badr angels were coming, mua`mameen (turbaned) and musawameen (with tails). That is tarfatu `ayn. Who
is not accepting, Islam is refusing them and their wrong understanding!
Jesus Christ (a) is not coming (without a head covering). O Wahabis! Put turbans on your heads! Ta`amamoo
wa tasawwamoo. At Badr Rasoolullah (s) said, "O my Companions! Angels are wearing turbans,

mua`mameen, and leaving taraf, the edge of turbans, musawwameen."
•••• •• ••••• ••• •••• •••• •••• ••• ••••••• ••• ••• : " •••••• ••• •••••••• •• ••••• •••••• •••••• •• ••••••• •••••••• " .
And Rasoolullah (s) took the edge of his turban and said, "O my ashaab, tasawamoo fa inna al-mala`ika qad
tawasawwamat (bi’s-soof al-abyad fee qalaanisihim)."
Make tails for indeed the angels have tails (on their turbans of white wool on their caps).
Rasoolullah (s) copied the angels’ example, as did the Sahaaba (r), and they began to fight the enemy.
O People! May Allah send us one of His beloved ones to first correct the Muslim world and then the whole
world. Jesus Christ (a) is coming with a turban on his head and a sword on his belt. That is a sign that he is
not coming as a prophet from Bani Isra’eel, but as a follower of the Seal of Prophets (s)!
O People! Come and listen. If you are not listening, something not good will come on your head. There will be
so many difficult days for all nations, but with turbans on their heads nothing can touch them. But those with
no covering, anything may touch them. And danger will reach all women who abandon their head covering
and arrows will touch on their heads. They are going to fall down and if all doctors are coming, they can't find
a way to make them not feel that pain on their head. Beware! Those days are approaching and you may
choose the real way of the sunnah the Seal of Prophets (s), and women may follow real Islamic orders and
they will be in safety. Or else from every seven, six are going to be touched by a heavenly spear and fall down
dead. May Allah forgive us!
O People! O People! Don't leave sunnat ar-Rasool if you are asking for salamat, safety and peace here and
Hereafter. If not, then you know:
•• ••••••••• ••• ••••••••
laa ikraaha fi ’d-deen,
There is no compulsion in religion. (al-Baqarah 2:256)
No one can force you, but with their goodwill they must follow Islamic orders. Particularly, they must try to
been seen as Muslims, men and women, and not to be modernized apes; we are not accepting that. We are
asking for forgiveness and we are asking that our feet should be fixed on the Right Way so that the Lord may

be pleased with us, for the honor of the most honored one, Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen wa ’l-Akhireen, Sayyidina
Muhammad (s).
Fatihah.
